cards.title: Mimikatz
cards.description_short: Tool for extracting credentials from Windows memory
cards.description_long: Mimikatz is a well-known post‑exploitation tool used to extract plaintext passwords, hashes, PINs, and Kerberos tickets from Windows memory. It is commonly used during penetration testing to analyze credential security.

main_commands.explanation: Enable debug privileges required for credential extraction
Dump password hashes from SAM database
List Kerberos tickets on the system

activity: Launch the Mimikatz console in a lab environment
Analyze password hashes and Kerberos tickets

cards.title: LinPEAS
cards.description_long: LinPEAS is part of the PEASS-ng suite and is used to search for possible privilege escalation paths on Linux systems. It scans system configurations, permissions, services, and credentials to identify weaknesses.

main_commands.explanation: Run LinPEAS to scan for privilege escalation opportunities
Save scan output to a file
Download and execute LinPEAS in one command

activity: Run LinPEAS on a Linux machine
Analyze SUID files and cron jobs

cards.title: WinPEAS
cards.description_long: WinPEAS is another tool in the PEASS-ng suite designed for Windows systems. It automates the discovery of potential privilege escalation vulnerabilities in Windows environments.

main_commands.explanation: Run WinPEAS to enumerate system information
Save enumeration output to a file

activity: Execute WinPEAS on a Windows system

cards.title: Empire
cards.description_long: Empire is a post‑exploitation framework that uses PowerShell and Python agents. It allows penetration testers to maintain persistence, execute commands, and manage compromised systems during a security assessment.

main_commands.explanation: Generate a stager for deploying an agent

activity: Connect an agent in a lab environment

cards.title: PowerSploit
cards.description_short: Collection of PowerShell scripts for post‑exploitation
cards.description_long: PowerSploit is a set of PowerShell modules designed for post‑exploitation tasks such as privilege escalation, credential harvesting, persistence, and reconnaissance in Windows environments.

main_commands.explanation: Perform network port scanning from compromised host
